rules.name: Thermodynamic Stability
rules.operational_summary: Energy above the convex hull retrieved from Materials Project metadata.

rules.name: Phonon Stability Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Heuristic proxy computed from mean coordination number and density.

rules.name: Coordination Environment
rules.operational_summary: Mean coordination number estimated using CrystalNN.

rules.name: Space Group Symmetry
rules.operational_summary: Crystallographic space group number computed using SpacegroupAnalyzer.

rules.name: Packing Density
rules.operational_summary: Crystal density computed from the structure.

rules.name: Band Gap (MP)
rules.operational_summary: Band gap retrieved from Materials Project metadata.

rules.name: Bond Length/Angle Deviation
rules.operational_summary: Deviation of local bond lengths and angles from typical reference values.

rules.name: Oxidation State Consistency
rules.operational_summary: Bond-valence-based assessment of oxidation-state and charge consistency.

rules.name: Lattice Strain
rules.operational_summary: Deviation among lattice parameters as a proxy for lattice distortion or strain.

rules.name: Prototype Similarity Score
rules.operational_summary: Structural similarity to known Materials Project structures using structure matching.

rules.name: Elemental Abundance Score
rules.operational_summary: Composition-weighted elemental abundance score based on Clarke abundance.

rules.name: Volume Per Atom
rules.operational_summary: Unit-cell volume divided by the number of atomic sites.

rules.name: Charge Neutrality Deviation
rules.operational_summary: Deviation from total charge neutrality estimated from bond-valence analysis.

rules.name: Bond Valence Sum Deviation
rules.operational_summary: Mean deviation between expected and estimated bond valence sums.

rules.name: Max Bond Angle Strain
rules.operational_summary: Maximum deviation of local bond angles from idealized coordination angles.

rules.name: Mechanical Stability Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Heuristic proxy based on density normalized by average atomic number.

rules.name: Elemental Toxicity/Volatility
rules.operational_summary: Fraction or weighted contribution of toxic, volatile, or highly reactive elements.

rules.name: Synthesis Temperature Estimate
rules.operational_summary: Composition-weighted average of elemental melting points.

rules.name: Phase Stability Window
rules.operational_summary: Categorical or continuous representation of energy-above-hull stability windows.

rules.name: Atomic Radii Mismatch
rules.operational_summary: Standard deviation of atomic radii normalized by their mean.

rules.name: Atoms Per Unit Cell
rules.operational_summary: Number of atomic sites in the unit cell.

rules.name: Electronegativity Difference
rules.operational_summary: Difference between maximum and minimum elemental electronegativity.

rules.name: Synthesis Analogue Count
rules.operational_summary: Number of known Materials Project entries in the same chemical system.

rules.name: Fraction Fully Occupied Sites
rules.operational_summary: Fraction of crystallographic sites with full occupancy.

rules.name: Void Fraction
rules.operational_summary: Estimated unoccupied volume fraction from atomic volumes and unit-cell volume.

rules.name: Polyhedral Connectivity
rules.operational_summary: Connectivity of coordinated framework cations or local coordination polyhedra.

rules.name: Absence of Mixed Valence
rules.operational_summary: Preference for a single or chemically consistent valence state.

rules.name: Min Interatomic Distance
rules.operational_summary: Shortest pairwise interatomic distance in the structure.

rules.name: Absence of Unstable Motifs
rules.operational_summary: Heuristic score for avoiding rare or unstable local coordination motifs.

rules.name: Elastic Anisotropy
rules.operational_summary: Zener-ratio-like or lattice-anisotropy-based proxy for elastic anisotropy.

rules.name: Defect Tolerance Indicator
rules.operational_summary: Variability in coordination environments as a proxy for defect tolerance.

rules.name: Max Coordination Number
rules.operational_summary: Maximum coordination number among all atomic sites.

rules.name: Unstable Magnetic/Electronic States
rules.operational_summary: Heuristic indicator based on partially filled d- or f-orbital configurations.

rules.name: Absence of Unstable/Volatile Elements
rules.operational_summary: Score reflecting avoidance of volatile or chemically unstable elements.

rules.name: Lattice Mismatch Minimum
rules.operational_summary: Minimum mismatch between the target lattice and known lattice motifs.

rules.name: Polyhedral Distortion Index
rules.operational_summary: Bond-length nonuniformity within local coordination polyhedra.

rules.name: Dimensional Anisotropy
rules.operational_summary: Ratio or spread of lattice parameters, such as maximum divided by minimum lattice length.

rules.name: Min Site Occupancy
rules.operational_summary: Lowest site occupancy value in the crystal structure.

rules.name: Fraction Metallic Bonding
rules.operational_summary: Fraction of near-neighbor bonds involving metal-metal pairs.

rules.name: Interlayer Distance Std
rules.operational_summary: Standard deviation of interlayer or c-axis neighbor distances.

rules.name: Framework Density
rules.operational_summary: Number of atoms per unit volume.

rules.name: Stoichiometry Deviation
rules.operational_summary: Standard deviation or irregularity of the reduced stoichiometric coefficients.

rules.name: Charge Balance Deviation
rules.operational_summary: Per-site or composition-level deviation from charge balance.

rules.name: Site Disorder Score
rules.operational_summary: Occupancy-based measure of crystallographic site disorder.

rules.name: Min Antisite Formation-Energy Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Proxy based on cation electronegativity similarity, related to antisite disorder tendency.

rules.name: Surface Energy Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Fraction of undercoordinated sites as a proxy for surface or interface instability.

rules.name: Synthesis Complexity Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Composite score based on number of elements, rare-earth content, and unusual coordination.

rules.name: Max Thermodynamic Stability Deviation
rules.operational_summary: Deviation of formation energy per atom or related thermodynamic quantity.

rules.name: Min Migration Barrier Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Proxy based on mobile-ion radius and structural density.

rules.name: Environmental Sensitivity Proxy
rules.operational_summary: Score reflecting the presence of air-, moisture-, or chemically reactive elements.
